subject: SOC 2 scope trim, log retention confirmation & Dedicated on-ramp plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Carr <tom.carr@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SOC 2 scope trim, log retention confirmation & Dedicated on-ramp plan

Tom / Acme security team –

Thanks again for taking the time today. As we discussed, Acme's renewal window (current term ends 2026-10-31) gives us an opportunity to both simplify the SOC 2 scope and finalize the Dedicated on-ramp you requested. To keep this tightly scoped for your auditors and procurement team, I want to confirm the asks we heard on the call and propose a short mutual action plan.

What Acme asked us to confirm:
- Exclude the analytics ingestion pipeline (Analytics Service) from the SOC 2 scope for the 2026 attestation period (effectively trimming the scope).
- Provide a signed attestation that Redwood will permanently delete archived application logs older than 18 months from the primary log store and provide a record of that deletion for auditors.
- Export a 90-day rolling window of audit logs (token-level metadata, service, timestamp, request-id) in a readable format for ingestion to Acme's SIEM.
- On-ramp to Redwood Dedicated Pool-2 (capacity increase: Dedicated Pool-2 baseline 8 vGPUs with burst to 12) aligned with renewal.

What we'll provide (proposed):
- Deletion attestation letter (signed by Redwood Compliance) and a manifest of deleted file identifiers + checksum list.
- One-time bulk export of requested audit logs in Parquet + JSON schema file; we can also provide a streaming forwarder to your SIEM for 90 days if you prefer.
- KMS rotation log and key metadata for the renewal period.
- Draft amendment that updates term (proposed 24 months), adds Dedicated Pool-2 with burst, and includes a narrow SOC 2 scope carve-out for the Analytics Service.

Proposed timeline (draft):
1) 2026-09-29: Redwood delivers evidence matrix and draft deletion attestation (internal review).
2) 2026-10-01: Acme confirms the scope trim and acceptance criteria for deletion evidence.
3) 2026-10-04: Redwood delivers log export sample + amendment draft.
4) 2026-10-11: Sign amendment via DocuSign and schedule Dedicated cutover.

Attachments: soc2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (matrix of artifacts & owners)

Can you confirm the scope exclusion language (Analytics Service) is sufficient for your auditors, and whether you want the export delivered as a one-time bulk file or via SIEM forwarding? I can loop in Dev to scope the export schema.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Carr <tom.carr@acmehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Security <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 scope trim, log retention confirmation & Dedicated on-ramp plan

Jasmine –

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Analytics Service scope exclusion sounds fine in principle; our external auditor (Claire Dunn) will want to see the exact service identifiers and proof that no customer PII flows through that pipeline. If you can provide a short system boundary diagram that names the Analytics Service components, that will help.
- For deletion proof: we need a signed attestation AND a machine-readable manifest of deleted object keys plus timestamps. A checksum is great. We also need a confirmation that backups older than 18 months will be purged or excluded from the attestation scope, and if so, the process and timeline for backup purges.
- For logs: we prefer a one-time encrypted Parquet export (S3 presigned link into our secure bucket) plus the JSON schema for mapping to our SIEM. However, for operational testing we'd like a 30-day SIEM forwarder trial before committing to the 90-day forwarding option.

Procurement (Elena) – please coordinate on the amendment language around term and Dedicated sizing; we will review pricing but prioritize the deletion attestation and log export for auditor readiness.

On quoting your original email: 
> Can you confirm the scope exclusion language (Analytics Service) is sufficient for your auditors, and whether you want the export delivered as a one-time bulk file or via SIEM forwarding?

We'll look for the system diagram + evidence matrix.

—Tom
Tom Carr
Head of Security
Acme Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 scope trim, log retention confirmation & Dedicated on-ramp plan

Jasmine / Dev —

Putting a short execution plan on the table so we can hit Acme's dates and satisfy both auditors and procurement. High level: compliance will author the deletion attestation; Infra will produce the Parquet export and optional SIEM forwarder; Legal/Product will produce the amendment with the exact scope carve-out.

Planned deliverables and owners:
- Deletion Attestation (Compliance): signed PDF + manifest (deleted_object_key, deletion_timestamp, checksum) — Laura (owner) — target 2026-09-29 (draft)
- Backup scope statement (Infra): explicit statement on whether backups are included/excluded and purge timeline — Dev (owner) — target 2026-10-01
- Log export (Infra): encrypted Parquet export, sample file (1 day) + JSON schema — Dev (owner) — target 2026-10-04
- System boundary diagram & evidence matrix — Jasmine (owner) — target 2026-09-29
- Amendment draft: term update (12→24 months option), Dedicated Pool-2 baseline (8 vGPUs) + Burst (to 12), SLA uplift for Dedicated (proposed 99.9) and pricing delta — Legal/Commercial — target 2026-10-04 (draft attached)

Note on pricing: ballpark uplift for Dedicated Pool-2 + burst and the longer term (24m) is provided in the attached amendment-draft-v1.pdf; final numbers will need confirmation from Commercial but expect ~18–25% uplift vs current plan depending on burst commitments. I'll attach the initial amendment for internal review.

Action items for Dev: please prepare the Parquet schema and a 1-day sample by 2026-10-04; include fields: timestamp_utc, service, request_id, user_id_hash, action, response_code, token_usage_estimate. Also confirm if we can sign the deletion attestation for backups or if backups require additional process (snapshot retention managed by CloudOps).

Attachments: amendment-draft-v1.pdf

I'll track these in the evidence matrix and ping Legal to ready a redline for Elena.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Tom Carr <tom.carr@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 scope trim, log retention confirmation & Dedicated on-ramp plan

Laura / Jasmine —

Thank you — Acme accepts the proposed approach contingent on the following before we sign:
1) We need the deletion attestation to explicitly call out backups (either included or a documented exclusion with purge schedule). The attestation must be signed and dated and provided as a PDF.
2) The amendment must include the Dedicated SLA at 99.9% for the Dedicated Pool-2 baseline (we will accept a 30-day grace on burst availability if needed).
3) Data residency: confirm all exported logs will be delivered to our US region bucket only.
4) Please provide the one-day Parquet sample and schema prior to legal redline; we want to validate fields.

If those items are in the draft amendment, Procurement is ready to proceed to signature. I've started a DocuSign envelope for the amendment (placeholder) — link below. Please send your redline to me by EOD 2026-10-06 so we can finalize before the renewal cutoff.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/12345-RDW-ACME-amendment
HubSpot deal: HS-987654

Procurement contact for PO and billing follow-up: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmehealth.com>

Best,
Elena Martinez
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
